name: Logo
description: Adobe logo atom in three versions (default wordmark 67×22, legacy lockup 50×24, abbreviated A-mark 24×24), themed per surface context via currentColor. Matches Figma component set 2956:2421 on the ↳ Logo page.

props.name: context
props.description: Surface context — drives the color token

notes: Rendered as role='img' with aria-label; inner SVGs are aria-hidden.
When used as a home link, wrap in an <a> and move the accessible name to the link.
SVG paths exported 1:1 from Figma variants with fills swapped to currentColor; color tokens applied in CSS exactly as bound per variant in Figma.
Legacy variant binds transparent-black-64 / transparent-white-48 (primitives) because that is what Figma binds — unusual vs the semantic content/* pair on the other versions.

Figma's SVG export of the legacy mark includes three zero-area line subpaths (the 'A' frame drawn as strokes); they do not render with fill and are preserved as exported — verify against Figma visually before shipping this variant anywhere prominent.
